meaning: An immutable in-memory build record joins selected existing native generators over one checked graph without changing their semantic contracts or output bytes.
selection: Explicit versioned generator requests, one checked graph and composition boundary, registered exact field/action/workflow dependencies, and one common module root. No implicit legacy fallback.
identity: Qualified domain selectors remain distinct. Native file identity is the existing generator-selected relative path within the selected layout, never an unqualified source name.
sources: Retain selected definition and profile source bytes with content hashes and request-key bindings. No filesystem rereads during planning; old source versions remain separately selectable only where explicitly supported.
join: Only identical file identity and exact content may deduplicate. Different content at one path, case-fold aliases, file/directory overlap and unresolved native leaf imports reject before any write.
surface: Inventory static named native exports and imports from the bounded generated module grammar. This is not a second domain parser or proof of native typing. Native compilation and independent source observation remain explicit verification obligations.
effects: Planning neither writes artifacts nor executes generated operations, policy targets, recovery, providers or publication. Candidate evidence grants no authority.
verification: same graph and source pin closure
